description: Source code for the MulticlassMetrics class in Apache Spark's MLlib evaluation module, providing metrics for multiclass classification such as confusion matrix, precision, recall, F-measure, accuracy, and log-loss.

classes.name: MulticlassMetrics
classes.description: Class for evaluating multiclass classification models, providing various metrics such as confusion matrix, precision, recall, F-measure, accuracy, Hamming loss, and log-loss.

methods.name: confusionMatrix
methods.description: Returns the confusion matrix as a dense matrix, with predicted classes in columns ordered by label.

methods.name: truePositiveRate
methods.description: Returns the true positive rate (recall) for a specified label.

methods.name: falsePositiveRate
methods.description: Returns the false positive rate for a specified label.

methods.name: precision
methods.description: Returns the precision for a specified label.

methods.name: recall
methods.description: Returns the recall for a specified label.

methods.name: fMeasure
methods.description: Calculates the F-measure for a label with a given beta.

methods.name: fMeasure
methods.description: Calculates the F1-measure for a label.

methods.name: accuracy
methods.description: Calculates the overall accuracy of the classifier.

methods.name: weightedTruePositiveRate
methods.description: Returns the weighted true positive rate.

methods.name: weightedFalsePositiveRate
methods.description: Returns the weighted false positive rate.

methods.name: weightedFMeasure
methods.description: Returns the weighted F-measure with specified beta.

methods.name: labels
methods.description: Returns the array of class labels in ascending order.

methods.name: logLoss
methods.description: Calculates the log-loss (cross-entropy loss) for multiclass predictions.
